kelly.name: Kelly Marine
kelly.bio: Kelly turns wish lists into keys-in-hand. From first call to closing table, she curates every showing, negotiates fiercely, and knows which street catches the sunrise — because she lives here too.

will.name: Will Henderson
will.script: Every home has a number. He finds the right one.
will.bio: Will architects the sale: pricing strategy built on live island comps, cinematic marketing, and negotiation that protects every dollar of your equity. Data first, handshake always.
